paper_container: Decision Corpus + Predictor Benchmark + Audit Protocol
question: On the fixed historical 931-pair same-pool test support, does uniform-spanning-tree edge weighting materially change predictor point estimates, clustered uncertainty or model rankings relative to uniform pair rows?

disclosure.schema_inventory_before_freeze: The historical static and TF-IDF JSONL rows were deserialized to verify field names, model/split counts and exact test support. No UST weights, UST-weighted outcome aggregate, UST-minus-raw shift or UST ranking was computed or emitted before this freeze.
not_computed_or_read_before_freeze: per-pair UST effective-resistance weights on the 931-pair support
historical support incidence rank and UST weight distribution
UST-weighted micro, task-macro or parent-macro values for any model
clustered confidence interval for any UST-minus-raw shift
disclosure.classification_policy: This is a deterministic post-disclosure sensitivity audit. Exact points, intervals and order changes are reported without a tunable success threshold; the frozen dev champion is never reselected on test. It cannot be called prospective confirmation.

estimands.graph_unit: Each connected component inside a fixed (task,parent) historical sibling comparison context.
estimands.edge_weight: Unweighted effective resistance b_e^T L^+ b_e, equivalently the edge inclusion probability under a uniform spanning tree of that component.
estimands.normalization: Weights sum to incidence rank separately per connected component and globally by Foster's identity.
model_metrics: paired task-clustered and parent-clustered UST-minus-uniform shifts
paired task-clustered and parent-clustered UST model-minus-TFIDF deltas
estimands.ranking_sensitivity: Report full 12-model and primary 5-model deterministic orders plus discordant unordered model pairs. Do not choose a new champion.
estimands.champion_robustness: Report the fixed champion's leave-one-task-out UST task-macro delta versus TF-IDF, including minimum, maximum and positive count.

inference.cluster_resampling: Resample task-level or (task,parent)-level aggregate points with replacement; report empirical order statistics 500 and 19499.
reported_flags: fixed champion UST task CI lower endpoint above 0.5
fixed champion paired UST delta versus TF-IDF task CI lower endpoint above 0
fixed champion paired UST delta versus TF-IDF parent CI lower endpoint above 0
fixed champion paired UST-minus-uniform task CI excludes 0
fixed champion paired UST-minus-uniform parent CI excludes 0

independent_implementations.producer: Per-component symmetric Laplacian eigendecomposition and Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse.
independent_implementations.verifier: Independent connected-component reconstruction and grounded reduced-Laplacian inverse; it does not import the producer.
independent_implementations.numeric_tolerance: producer 5e-9 and verifier 2e-8 relative to max(1,magnitude)
synthetic_controls: K_4 gives every edge weight 1/2 and total rank 3
a tree gives every edge weight 1
disconnected subgraphs inside one parent are accounted as separate components
tie or abstention receives exactly neutral 1/2 credit
raw-versus-UST ranking discordance is independently reconstructed

integrity.failure_policy: Any source hash, schema, support, graph, identity, trace, test, byte or arithmetic mismatch stops without scientific classification.

allowed: Whether UST/rank weighting is outcome-material or ranking-material on this already revealed historical same-pool benchmark.
Whether the previously frozen static champion remains above chance and/or superior to TF-IDF under this alternate audit metric.
forbidden: effective sample size or independent-label count
invalidity of any prior benchmark accuracy
